description: Build the current brand-registry source with the shipped compiler kit and server dependencies. apply:true compiles in an isolated artifact directory, returns requested-brand/theme CSS variables, CSS and JSON inline, and writes five artifacts with paths, hashes and sizes. Full CSS includes all registered scopes; TypeScript and Tailwind retain A/light defaults. Source and shipped runtime files are never changed. Without apply it lists the artifacts it would create and writes nothing, including no run record. A missing compiler kit returns OODS-N011; a failed compiler returns OODS-S019 with its output.

brand.description: Selects values compiled from current source, returned inline as CSS variables, CSS and JSON and written on apply. Full CSS includes all registered scopes; TypeScript and Tailwind artifacts retain A/light defaults.

name: tokens_build
